	wget -O redis.tar.gz "$REDIS_DOWNLOAD_URL"; 	echo "$REDIS_DOWNLOAD_SHA *redis.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; 	mkdir -p /usr/src/redis; 	tar -xzf redis.tar.gz -C /usr/src/redis --strip-components=1; 	rm redis.tar.gz; 		grep -E '^ *createBoolConfig[(]"protected-mode",.*, *1 *,.*[)],$' /usr/src/redis/src/config.c; 	sed -ri 's!^( *createBoolConfig[(]"protected-mode",.*, *)1( *,.*[)],)$!\10\2!' /usr/src/redis/src/config.c; 	grep -E '^ *createBoolConfig[(]"protected-mode",.*, *0 *,.*[)],$' /usr/src/redis/src/config.c; 		gnuArch="$(dpkg-architecture --query DEB_BUILD_GNU_TYPE)"; 	extraJemallocConfigureFlags="--build=$gnuArch"; 	dpkgArch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; 	case "${dpkgArch##*-}" in 		amd64 | i386 | x32) extraJemallocConfigureFlags="$extraJemallocConfigureFlags --with-lg-page=12" ;; 		*) extraJemallocConfigureFlags="$extraJemallocConfigureFlags --with-lg-page=16" ;; 	esac; 	extraJemallocConfigureFlags="$extraJemallocConfigureFlags --with-lg-hugepage=21"; 	grep -F 'cd jemalloc && ./configure ' /usr/src/redis/deps/Makefile; 	sed -ri 's!cd jemalloc && ./configure !&'"$extraJemallocConfigureFlags"' !' /usr/src/redis/deps/Makefile; 	grep -F "cd jemalloc && ./configure $extraJemallocConfigureFlags " /usr/src/redis/deps/Makefile; 		export BUILD_TLS=yes; 	make -C /usr/src/redis -j "$(nproc)" all; 	make -C /usr/src/redis install; 		rm -r /usr/src/redis; 		runDeps="$( 		scanelf --needed --nobanner --format '%n#p' --recursive /usr/local 			| tr ',' '\n' 			| sort -u 			| awk 'system("[ -e /usr/local/lib/" $1 " ]") == 0 { next } { print "so:" $1 }' 	)"; 	apk add --no-network --virtual .redis-rundeps $runDeps; 	apk del --no-network .build-deps; 		redis-cli --version; 	redis-server --version; # buildkit

repo.description: Self-hosted Shadow AI discovery and governance. Evidence-first visibility across network, endpoints, Active Directory and Entra ID.
repo.name: open-shadow-ai

pull_request.body:
Production installation needs bounded admission, recoverable queues, reliable readiness signals and evidence tied to the images actually deployed. This change implements those controls and adds an isolated qualification lab with measurable failure and restoration scenarios.

- Bound SSO state creation and provider calls; fail closed when admission cannot be verified.
- Enforce queue capacity and reference accounting, retain unacknowledged/dead-letter data, and provide controlled replay, reconciliation and archival garbage collection. Preserve delivery of older agent batches.
- Add worker progress probes, operational alerts and physical resource measurements.
- Lock dependencies and build inputs; verify complete OCI evidence and scan the actual runtime inventory on both architectures. Maintain four service-image recipes with pinned Go/source/module/APK inputs. Main-branch attestation covers verified archives; no registry publication is introduced.
- Add labeled detection evaluation, load/fault/pressure/probe exercises, cold restoration and guarded disposable-resource cleanup. Read-only Kubernetes rendering and IdP checks expose their qualification limits.

The OCI scanner uses byte-identical private layouts with verified blob hashes and unchanged-snapshot checks. Temporary containers retain name/image evidence across journal resumes. A bounded, secret-safe worker diagnostic preserves the original installation failure code.

Independent local verification: 245 image/scanner tests, 196 qualification tests and 99 diagnostic/monitoring tests passed. Eight POSIX cases require Linux and one Promtool test requires the real tool; mandatory hosted checks cover these execution environments. Twelve official image indexes and both architecture manifests were independently verified. Ruff and workflow validation passed.

Hosted native builds, APK signature checks, all 18 image scans and actual Compose/pressure/restoration exercises are required before accepting this PR. Local results do not establish their success.

Documentation: [delivery](https://github.com/alebgl77/open-shadow-ai/blob/codex/production-hardening-lots/docs/production-delivery.md), [qualification](https://github.com/alebgl77/open-shadow-ai/blob/codex/production-hardening-lots/docs/production-qualification.md), [worker diagnostics](https://github.com/alebgl77/open-shadow-ai/blob/codex/production-hardening-lots/docs/worker-diagnostics.md).

Deployment remains one organization per installation with external stores for the Kubernetes profile. Real IdP/MFA, AD fleet, Kubernetes HA, representative detection accuracy and production sizing/RPO/RTO still require the target environment. Browser-based IdP execution fails closed until containment is supported. The bounded frontend parser mitigation remains documented; a clean named-package audit does not imply physical parser removal.
